sections.h2: India imports 100% of its potash and 95% of its phosphate requirements

chart.title: Import dependence is near total for potash and phosphate
chart.sub: Share of requirement, %; the gas rows show the urea link.
chart.source: PRS Legislative Research, summary of Standing Committee on Chemicals and Fertilisers report, 1 December 2025.
chart.accent: India's import dependence for potash requirements

sections.means: The committee puts India's import dependence at 100% for potash and 95% for phosphate.
sections.todo: What to do: back the committee's call for long-term supply agreements and joint ventures for phosphate and potash.

sections.h2: Urea's cost is 90% natural gas, and 74% of that gas is not domestic

chart.title: Most of urea's gas cost is not sourced at home
chart.sub: Shares, %; the not-domestic share is 100 minus the domestic 26.
chart.source: PRS Legislative Research, summary of Standing Committee on Chemicals and Fertilisers report, 1 December 2025.
chart.accent: Natural gas share of urea cost
rows: Natural gas share of urea cost

sections.means: Natural gas makes up 90% of urea's production cost, and only 26% of that gas is sourced domestically.
sections.todo: What to do: rework India's gas procurement mechanism to secure steady supply at competitive prices, as the committee recommends.

sections.h2: 27 of 33 operating urea plants are more than 25 years old

chart.source: PRS Legislative Research, summary of Standing Committee on Chemicals and Fertilisers report, 1 December 2025.

sections.means: The committee says the sector needs a technology transition within five years.
sections.todo: What to do: set up the dedicated task force the committee proposes to upgrade, modernise and revive these plants.
